senses.gloss: देवऋषि deva-ṛṣi, m. ṛṣi, among the gods, 🞄divine saint.

देवक déva-ka, —˚ a. = deva;
 ī, f. N. of 🞄Kṛṣṇaʼs mother.

देवकीनन्दन devakī-nandana, m. met. of 🞄Kṛṣṇa;
 -sūnu, m. id..

देवतागार devatā‿ā̆gāra, n. temple, chapel;
 🞄-gṛha, n. id..

देवतात् devá-tāt, f. divine worship;
 — host.
देवतुमुल deva-tumula, n. thunderstorm.

देवन dév-ana, n. shining;
 gambling.
देवयत् deva-yát, den. pr. pt. serving the gods.

देवर dev-ara, m. husbandʼs (younger) brother, 🞄brother-in-law;
 lover, husband: -ghnī, 🞄a. f. killing her brother-in-law.

देवल deva-la, m. showman of images (also 🞄-ka);
 Ṇ.
देवानांप्रिय devānāṃ-priya, m. (favourite of 🞄the gods), plain simple man.
देविका dév-ikā, f. subordinate goddess.
देवृ dev-ṛ́, m. husbandʼs (younger) brother, 🞄brother-in-law.
देवैनस deva‿enasá, n. curse of the gods.
देव्यायतन devī‿āyatana, n. temple of Durgā.
